name: What factors should I consider when determining the asking price for my luxury property?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when determining the asking price for my luxury property?

acceptedAnswer.text: When setting the asking price for a luxury property, consider factors such as recent comparable sales in your specific sub-market (e.g., Fisher Island vs. Pinecrest), unique property features, condition, amenities, and current market demand. Overpricing can lead to longer market times, while underpricing may leave money on the table. A professional market analysis, informed by local expertise, is essential to establish a competitive and realistic price. Kelby Contreras provides a comprehensive comparative market analysis for luxury homes in our service areas, including Miami-Dade and Broward Counties.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider comparable sales, unique features, condition, amenities, and market demand when pricing a luxury property; a professional market analysis is essential.
